title: Pluralistic Alignment for Healthcare: A Role-Driven Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the diversity of ethical perspectives generated by LLMs in healthcare scenarios using the VITAL benchmark. This includes measuring value coverage (Overton mode) via an NLI model, evaluating conditioned generation accuracy (Steerable mode) using LLM-as-a-Judge and human evaluation, and assessing alignment with diverse human opinions (Distributional mode).

Comparing the probability distributions of model-generated responses against empirical human opinion distributions and health surveys from diverse populations using Jensen-Shannon divergence to measure alignment with global pluralistic views.
